title: Living Independently Through a Disrupted Season

body.en: Prince, who is blind, has lived alone and managed his own household for six years — his own systems, his own routines, all built around knowing his home and street by memory and touch. When flooding forced a temporary move to a relative's house across town, all of that vanished overnight. New layout, new obstacles, no familiar landmarks. It took him nearly three weeks to feel steady again — not because he couldn't adapt, but because nobody had thought to walk him through the new space properly on day one. A five-minute orientation would have saved him three difficult weeks.
